reviews.name: Corbin V
reviews.title: Highly Recommend KLM Safaris - A Memorable and Sustainable Experience
reviews.quote: My partner and I had a fantastic time with KLM Safaris on the Materuni Waterfall and Coffee Tour. Our guide, Frank, was outstanding—his deep knowledge of the land and sustainability, thanks to his background in geography and the environment, really stood out. Frank’s English was excellent, and he was kind and patient, never rushing us. KLM Safaris’ commitment to sustainability was impressive, making the experience even more rewarding. For a tour that blends natural beauty with responsible practices, I highly recommend KLM Safaris. A big thanks to Frank and the team for an unforgettable day!

reviews.name: Traveler Adventure
reviews.title: Enjoyable detour to the materuni village
reviews.quote: Detour to materuni village makes a memory, starts from Moshi town heading to the village. Meet chagga culture,banana and coffee plantation when locally prepared and the taste was wonderful. Local food and local beer the dance. At waterfalls it's a beautiful place to relax ans swim, that expirience ........

reviews.name: Matt W
reviews.title: Consider other options
reviews.quote: The walk to the waterfalls was not that interesting. The waterfall itself was not amazing and if you've seen any number of waterfalls you won't be that impressed by it. The process of roasting and grinding coffee and lunch at a small village was interesting, however we felt the entire trip was designed to extract as much money as possible in the way of constant tips at every corner or discussion had with any local. Am on the fence whether the tour was enjoyable or not.

reviews.name: Anne Amsterdam
reviews.title: Beautiful tour
reviews.quote: A beautiful, natural place. Do not overflow and crystal clear water. It's worth a visit. Our guide Augustino was just great. Very accommodating and he knows the land, vegetation, people and culture very well. You learn a lot of exciting information and feel very safe. A very dear person. We never had a better guide.

reviews.name: Pat J
reviews.title: A great day in great places!
reviews.quote: A beautiful, natural place. Don't overrun and it's worth a visit. Our guide Augustino was just great! Very accommodating and he knows the land, vegetation, people and culture very well. You learn a lot of exciting information and feel very safe. A very dear person. We never had a better guide! The coffee experience is very special and recommended. You can accompany the coffee process yourself and taste the fresh, organic coffee! In order for the coffee to be good, a lot is sung and danced loud and loud during the processing for motivation. After the effort over coffee there is a great "Africa mom food" with banana soup and local food, banana beer on surcharge. The waterfall is very nice and reachable after a medium-short hike. Be sure to bring your walking sticks in case of rain or wet ground!

reviews.name: Kudirat Anike
reviews.title: Excellent first-day tour in Tanzania Our
reviews.quote: first day in Tanzania was fantastic, filled with a guided waterfall walk and coffee tour. With our jet lag, the tour leader kept the ideal leisurely pace for us, and the sights from the hike were breathtaking. The coffee trip was fascinating, if only for the opportunity to interact with and observe the locals. It was wonderful to be able to help them out by purchasing some delectable coffee and beer with bananas!

reviews.name: Oyogu Lawrence
reviews.title: I went on numerous beautiful day outings with KLM Safaris
reviews.quote: I went on numerous beautiful day outings with KLM Safaris, including trips to Lake Chala, the Materuni waterfalls and coffee experience, and the Chemka hot springs. The exciting knowledge and observation were combined with an excellent and memorable moment. I advise everyone to select this firm while planning a tour in Tanzania.

reviews.name: Alexa Hopkins
reviews.title: Excellent service The three day trip was fantastic
reviews.quote: "I had an incredible experience with KLM Safaris, thanks to our exceptional guide, Elly. Her deep knowledge of the wildlife and passion for conservation made the safari truly unforgettable. Elly's expertise and enthusiasm brought every moment to life, from tracking elusive animals to sharing fascinating insights about the ecosystem. The entire trip was well-organized and exceeded all expectations. If you're looking for a top-notch safari experience, I highly recommend KLM Safaris and Elly as your guide

reviews.name: jpowers11
reviews.title: This is the tour you want!
reviews.quote: Such a fun and rewarding experience! Loved it from start to finish. Our guide was patient with us as we hiked to the waterfall, explaining about the tribe and village along the way. The coffee experience was by far my favorite though. Processing our own cup of coffee from the bean to cup was aaaammmaazing. And the sweet men and women of the village were so endearing as they cheered us on with their songs. The lunch was surprisingly tasty and filling with a good variety. You can buy some coffee, honey, or banana beer and other souveniers to support the village, which I highly recommend! Don't miss this tour! ALSO, i have compared similar tours and KLM seemed to offer the best value for money so I advise you book with them. Cheers and enjoy Tanzania!!

reviews.name: Khadija Abubakar
reviews.title: Wonderful waterfalls
reviews.quote: We were moving very slowly over the difficult and slick terrain, so Joel, our tour guide, was very competent, professional, and patient with us. There is severe road construction on the route to the hotsprings. Our journey is exceedingly uneven and lacks paved roads.
